title: Coarse-grained ground-state certification for spin chains
status: Partial: the infinite XXZ benchmark and scalable coarse-RDM implementation are complete; exact certification and the full challenge target grid remain open.

model.name: infinite spin-1/2 XXZ chain
model.hamiltonian: H = sum_i (Sx_i Sx_{i+1} + Sy_i Sy_{i+1} + Delta Sz_i Sz_{i+1})
model.symmetry: standalone U(1); standalone spin-flip Z2 implemented separately

method.name: MPS-guided coarse-grained reduced-density-matrix semidefinite relaxation
method.exact: Floating-point lower estimates with reconstructed dual diagnostics; not yet exact certificates
method.settings: two-site real U(1)-symmetric VUMPS; D=4,5,6; coarse depths 3-60; primary point D=6, depth=60
method.note: The frozen MPS defines fixed coarse maps. It supplies a variational upper endpoint but is never imposed as lower-bound state data.

estimate.wall_time: 2 h 12 min Slurm elapsed; 5,621 s solve/post-processing

figures.scope: D=6 corrected numerical lower estimate versus coarse depth
